parcel.description: Parcel plan orchestrator. Start a new parcel plan for a feature description, walk the 10-phase pass-the-parcel workflow, and delegate to ptp-* sub-agents. Use when: 'parcel', '/parcel', 'pass the parcel', 'parcel mode', multi-agent planning, token-saving planning.

wiki-writer.description: Write and rewrite wiki documents in plain, even, front-loaded prose. Use when: writing, editing, rewriting, cleaning up, rebalancing, refreshing or restructuring any document in .wiki/ or a knowledge base.

ptp-context-hunter.description: Parcel Context Hunter sub-agent. Executes Phases 1-3 of a parcel plan by loading the ptp-context-hunter skill, locking the scope perimeter, gathering wiki-first context, and producing Phase 3 user clarification questions.

ptp-phase3-answerer.description: Phase 3.5 AUTO-mode sub-agent. Auto-resolves Phase 3 user clarification questions from the Research Map populated by ptp-context-hunter, recording Unresolvable entries for genuinely blocked questions.

ptp-high-visionary.description: Phase 4-5 sub-agent. Writes the wiki requirements spec + acceptance criteria (Phase 4) and the standard implementation plan (Phase 5) into the parcel plan file, enforcing the Simplicity Ladder.

ptp-grumpy-architect.description: Phase 6 sub-agent. Ruthlessly audits the plan's spec and logic for completeness, edge cases, boundary collisions, YAGNI bloat, and architectural anti-patterns. Writes an isolated review file.

ptp-smooth-operator.description: Phase 7 sub-agent. Reviews the plan's product vision, user journey, and UX for bloat and complexity. Writes an isolated review file.

ptp-code-surgeon.description: Parcel Executor sub-agent. Executes Phases 8-9 of a parcel plan by loading the ptp-code-surgeon skill, applying Phase 5 edits with single-pass direct-to-disk execution and ponytail coding style, and running build/lint/test verification. Only triggers after Gate B is cleared by explicit user input.

wiki-verifier.description: Wiki verification sub-agent. Validates wiki documents against live codebase reality step-by-step, surfacing drift, gaps, and stale content for the true-or-false workflow.
